payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Donella, Jennette, Onie, Tiana

payload.content: Hello everyone, I am Tiana. I have 4 hours availability and strong skills in machine-learning. I am considering tasks related to machine-learning triage or review since they fit my availability and skill set best. I would like to know if anyone else is interested in those tasks or if there are other task preferences from others I should consider.

Hello Tiana and team! I have 7 hours available and strong skills in machine-learning. I'm considering tasks related to machine-learning, especially triage, review, or docs since my cost for those is lower compared to implementation or testing. I am interested in coordinating so we don't overlap on the same tasks. Anyone else interested in machine-learning tasks or other tasks? Let's aim to cover as many tasks as possible without duplication.

Also, I noticed there are backend tasks available. If anyone prefers backend tasks, please let me know so I can avoid those and focus on machine-learning tasks. Coordination will help us maximize our efficiency.

Hello Tiana and team, I have 4 hours availability with strong backend and machine-learning skills. Given my costs and availability, I am considering backend implementation (cost 1.84, effort 2.0) or backend review (cost 0.92, effort 1.0) tasks. I prefer to avoid high-cost machine-learning implementation and testing due to effort and cost. Please share your preferences so we can avoid task overlaps and cover more tasks efficiently.

Hello team, Jennette here with 6 hours availability and strong machine-learning skill. I am interested in machine-learning triage or review tasks since they balance effort and cost well for me. Let's coordinate to avoid overlaps. Onie and Tiana, you mentioned interest in similar tasks, so we can distribute these among us for maximum coverage.

Jennette here. I am focusing on machine-learning triage or review tasks to complement others' backend preferences and maximize task coverage. Let's coordinate to avoid duplicates and cover more ground efficiently.

Hello all, Tiana here. I see several of us are interested in machine-learning triage and review tasks. Jennette and Onie also expressed interest in these. To maximize coverage, I suggest Jennette take the triage task, Onie take the docs or review, and I could take review if it remains open. Donella, since you prefer backend tasks, focusing on backend implement or review sounds great. Let's confirm preferences to avoid overlaps and cover more tasks efficiently.

Following up on task preferences: Jennette, are you comfortable taking the machine-learning triage task? Onie, would you prefer to take the machine-learning docs or review task? I can then focus on the review task or adjust depending on your choices. Donella, please confirm your preferred backend task so we can finalize our assignments efficiently.

Hello all, Onie here. I am inclined to take the machine-learning docs task due to its reasonable cost and moderate effort, leaving the review and triage tasks to Jennette and Tiana respectively for optimal coverage and lower total cost. Donella, your backend implementation and review preferences sound great for covering those tasks efficiently. Let's confirm this distribution to avoid overlaps and maximize task coverage.

I recommend Jennette take the machine-learning triage task, Tiana take the machine-learning review task, and I take the machine-learning docs task. Donella can focus on backend implementation or review. This way, the tasks are distributed to maximize coverage and minimize overlap. Please share your thoughts or any conflicts you see.

Hello everyone, based on your preferences and my backend skills and availability, I am leaning towards taking the backend implementation task (ISSUE-0002::implement) due to its moderate effort and cost. Does anyone else have interest in backend tasks to confirm no overlap? Also, I support Jennette, Onie, and Tiana's proposed distribution of machine-learning triage, review, and docs tasks for maximum coverage.

Jennette confirms preference for the machine-learning triage task (ISSUE-0001::triage) to complement Onie taking the docs task and Tiana the review task. This distribution helps maximize task coverage and minimize overlaps. Jennette supports Donella taking backend implementation. Looking forward to finalizing assignments soon.
